```sql
SELECT d37208_product_class_name AS "产品名称", SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS "工单数量" FROM t_data_assistant_incident WHERE d37208_incident_month = SUBSTR(DATE('now', '-1 year'), 1, 4) || '-06' GROUP BY d37208_product_class_name ORDER BY "工单数量" ASC LIMIT 3
```
